source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard must define one primary responsibility and declare triggers, non-goals, I/O, dependencies, references, tests, evidence, and lifecycle boundaries.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this complete standard declaration set.
source_gap_claims.subject: Standard declaration sections

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must reject a governed fixture when a required declaration or its referenced section is missing.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires rejection of missing A01 declaration sections or referenced sections.
source_gap_claims.subject: Missing required section rejection

source_gap_claims.behavior: A missing-section diagnostic must identify the applicable rule and relative location rather than accepting headings alone.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this A01 diagnostic content or location precision.
source_gap_claims.subject: A01 diagnostic specificity

source_gap_claims.behavior: The versioned quality contract schema must accept a valid contract and record capabilities explicitly.
source_gap_claims.reason: Supplied schema obligations concern reference-package validation and result shape, but do not require this quality-contract acceptance and explicit capability recording behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Valid quality contract

source_gap_claims.behavior: The quality contract schema must reject unsupported versions, malformed types, undeclared fields in its owned namespace, and unresolved references.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation enumerates these quality-contract schema rejection rules.
source_gap_claims.subject: Quality contract schema rejection

source_gap_claims.behavior: A typo in a capability or schema version must fail validation and must not silently become an empty or disabled capability.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this specific typo and silent-disable failure behavior.
source_gap_claims.subject: Capability and version typo handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must validate frontmatter, require nonempty name and description, and enforce canonical package-name consistency with the declared Skill identity.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these frontmatter and package-identity checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Frontmatter and package identity

source_gap_claims.behavior: Missing or malformed frontmatter, duplicate keys, conflicting name values, and unsupported frontmatter extensions must be rejected.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these A03 frontmatter negative cases; documentation of supported keys does not require validator rejection.
source_gap_claims.subject: Frontmatter rejection cases

source_gap_claims.behavior: Frontmatter parsing must be safe such that YAML or object constructors never execute.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied safe-parsing baseline is general and does not explicitly require non-execution of YAML/object constructors for frontmatter.
source_gap_claims.subject: Frontmatter parser safety

source_gap_claims.behavior: The validator must enforce fewer than 500 logical lines in SKILL.md while counting frontmatter, blank lines, and code blocks.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires the A04 logical-line limit or its counting scope.
source_gap_claims.subject: SKILL.md logical-line limit

source_gap_claims.behavior: A 499-line SKILL.md must pass while 500- and 501-line files must fail.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these exact A04 boundary outcomes.
source_gap_claims.subject: A04 line-count boundaries

source_gap_claims.behavior: Logical-line counting must give LF and CRLF identical results, and a final newline must not add an extra logical line.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these line-ending and final-newline normalization rules.
source_gap_claims.subject: A04 line-count normalization

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard must recommend a smaller main file without introducing a second hard line-count gate.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires this recommendation or prohibition on a second hard gate.
source_gap_claims.subject: A04 recommendation and single gate
